conclusion: All52 physical comparisons pass,3120 full ticks. Large restored late-debris benefit repeats:382.883ms versus422.663/426.525ms controls,9.82% versus pooled control in this cohort. Earlier independent20/20/20 result was357.108 versus395.160/396.107ms; do not combine cohorts. First-impact, cold-panel and city64 cascade losses do not consistently repeat in reversed order. Warm600 heavy mean advantage remains~0.079ms, with519/600 60Hz misses unchanged. Warm180 fracture-burst repeat is161.241 versus166.641/163.340ms; modest event benefit, not a whole-game speedup. All52 normal asynchronous memory cases pass,104 ticks,567.53s diagnostic wall. Retain the isolated capacity change; no promotion of N14 or installed SDK.
timing_correction: Original half-length control screen remains unqualified for timing: different first-use weight. Corrected cohorts have equal process lengths, including all first ticks. No tolerance or workload changed.
